subject: Post bill-run: unapplied payments + VAT tagging — proposed ledger sweep
messages:
From: OrbitalCloud Billing <billing@orbitalcloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Unapplied payment + VAT tag anomaly on April bill run

Hi Naomi,

We ran month-end cash application and noticed ~€28,450 across three invoices (INV-2027-0410, INV-2027-0421, INV-2027-0430) are showing as unapplied in your AR feed. Our lockbox shows the payments hit our account on 2027-04-02, but when we pulled the Redwood remittance file the payment reference strings are missing and two of the payments were tagged with UK VAT 20% (should be 0% export).

Can you confirm whether Redwood changed the bill-run mapping last week? These unapplied amounts are blocking our internal revenue recognition for April. We're also seeing a mismatched credit on INV-2027-0421 that might be a post-bill credit your team issued.

Attaching our summary CSV and a screenshot of our applied payments grid. Let me know what info you need from our side.

thanks,
Kate Rivera
Billing Manager – OrbitalCloud
attachments: billing_exceptions_20270420.csv, oc_applied_grid.png
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Unapplied payment + VAT tag anomaly on April bill run

Forwarding OrbitalCloud's note — they hit us with three unapplied payments and a VAT tagging mismatch after the April bill run. See attached CSV from them (billing_exceptions_20270420.csv).

Initial thoughts: we had a config tweak on 2027-04-01 to strip non-numeric characters from remittance_ref to improve matching (PR#742). That likely removed a structured reference OrbitalCloud uses. Also our EU VAT fallback tag was recently toggled for export accounts; may be misclassifying a subset.

Proposed next steps:
- Marcus: can you run a mapping report (remittance_ref -> payment_id) and confirm which payment_ids correspond to the three invoices? If matching exists, we can post internal ledger entries to apply them.
- Lauren: we'll need a journal sweep template and tax reclaim path for the VAT error (if we reclassify VAT from 20%->0% after settlements).
- Aditya: if we need to issue a corrective credit note from Redwood, we should prepare the credit note and route for signature. OrbitalCloud is asking for evidence to close their AR so they can do revenue recognition.

I'm putting a temporary pause on any auto-sweep that would net these against other open balances — want to preserve audit trail.

— Naomi
Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

>

> - Marcus: can you run a mapping report (remittance_ref -> payment_id) and confirm which payment_ids correspond to the three invoices? If matching exists, we can post internal ledger entries to apply them.

I've pulled the remittance audit and reconciled the lockbox trace. Matching found for two of the three payments when ignoring non-numeric padding — payment_ids P-99871 and P-99893 map to INV-2027-0410 and INV-2027-0430. The middle one (INV-2027-0421) is the one with the post-bill credit applied by Redwood on 2027-04-03; the credit entry C-4658 removed the invoice reference from the remittance string so lockbox couldn't auto-apply it.

I've prepared a journal sweep suggestion (see attached journal_sweep_template.xlsx) to:
- Credit unapplied cash account 1130 by €28,450
- Debit accounts receivable 1200 to apply to the three invoices (split per attached CSV tab)
- Post VAT adjustment: debit VAT payable 2201 for €4,750 and credit VAT suspense 2299 to correct the mis-tagged 20% -> 0% on export services

Questions before we post:
1) Do we have OrbitalCloud's signed confirmation that they accept Redwood's reclassification so the tax team has a paper trail?
2) Do we want to record the sweep on 2027-04-22 (after we finish the review) or backdate to 2027-04-03 when the credit impacted matching? Audit prefers 4/22 with memo referencing original posting dates.

I'll hold until we get Lauren to confirm tax reclaim path and until Naomi authorizes the timing.

— Marcus
Senior Ledger Accountant
Redwood Inference
attachments: journal_sweep_template.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unapplied payment + VAT tag anomaly on April bill run

Thanks Marcus — good find. A few points from tax/controls:

- For EU export services where the counterparty confirms non-UK use, VAT should be 0%. We need OrbitalCloud to confirm in writing (email is fine) that those three invoices are export services. That will be the support for the VAT reclassification.
- On timing: do not backdate the sweep to 4/03. Post on 4/22 with explicit memo and link to the OrbitalCloud confirm and the drive folder. That keeps our controls intact.
- For the VAT reclaim: we'll move the VAT amount from VAT payable -> VAT suspense, then prepare a reclaim submission for the VAT team to process next filing. If OrbitalCloud has already reclaimed on their side, we need to coordinate so we don't double-claim.

Action items:
- Naomi: can you request a short confirmation email from OrbitalCloud confirming export status for these invoices and permission to reclassify VAT?
- Marcus: once we have confirmation, post the journal using the template and include detailed memos (invoice refs, payment_ids, original posting dates).
- Aditya: if we need to issue a credit note for the netting that removed the invoice ref, draft the credit and include credit note number for audit.

I'll review the posted journal before it goes to ledger.

— Lauren
Director, Tax & Controls
Redwood Inference

Kate,

Thanks for the quick flag — appreciate the CSV. We think the root cause is our remittance_ref normalization + a post-bill credit that stripped the invoice reference for INV-2027-0421. We have a clean plan:

1) If you can confirm these three invoices are EU export services (reply-all with a one-line confirmation), we will reclassify the VAT to 0% and post a journal sweep on 2027-04-22 to apply the payments.
2) We'll attach the posted journal and the sweep memos to the ticket for your audit.
3) If you prefer a credit note instead of internal re-application, we can issue a signed credit note (we've prepared one and attached signed_credit_note_OC-772.pdf) — please confirm which option you want.

We will not backdate entries — posting will be 2027-04-22 with memos to preserve audit trail. Lauren will review the VAT path. Marcus will post the journal after your confirmation.

Best,
Naomi
